description.value:
Reacting to danger, you conjure a faintly glowing 10-foot-radius sphere of protection around yourself that lasts for the duration. A tech power, or a force power dealing energy or lightning damage, of 7th level or lower cast from outside the sphere cannot affect anything within it, even from a higher-level slot; such a power may still target things inside, but has no effect on them, and its area of effect cannot extend into the sphere.

Physical or energy projectiles, single-target hazards such as a detonator's blast, and environmental dangers like falling debris or a lava flow cannot pass through the sphere or affect anything inside it.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a tech slot of 8th level or higher, the sphere's radius grows by 10 feet, and it blocks powers of one level higher, for each slot level beyond 7th.
